ai_summary: Grob Tea Company Limited has successfully completed the acquisition of 100% equity in Bazaloni Group Limited for Rs. 72.16 Crores, establishing it as a wholly-owned subsidiary to strategically expand its footprint and enhance profitability in the tea industry. This material transaction incorporates Bazaloni's profitable operations (FY26 turnover Rs. 52.78 Cr, net profit Rs. 6.88 Cr), though the significant cash outlay represents a substantial investment relative to the target's recent financial performance.
